records.issue_text: pkg/apiserver/rest/dualwriter_mode3.go:45 — Unified-store Create failures use recordLegacyDuration, incorrectly attributing failures to legacy storage and omitting unified-store failure observations.
records.rationale: The finding identifies real metric recording bugs in the diff. In Create() at line 45, when storage fails, it calls `d.recordLegacyDuration(true, mode3Str, options.Kind, method, startStorage)` - recording a storage failure as a legacy duration. In DeleteCollection() at line 119, the goroutine calls `d.recordStorageDuration(err != nil, mode3Str, options.Kind, method, startLegacy)` - recording legacy operation duration as storage duration. These are clear copy-paste errors that will corrupt the metrics by attributing errors and durations to the wrong backend.
